description: ZALF published a six-year field dataset from three Müncheberg plots in Germany covering 1992–1998. The plots represent intensive, organic and extensive management of mainly sandy Eutric Cambisol soil. The record combines soil water and nitrogen, crop growth and yield formation, weather and field management at differing observation intervals. The data supported a workshop on modelling water and nutrient dynamics in soil-crop systems. The named public ZALF GeoNode resource opened, and DataCite lists XML and CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 with no fee indicated. A food-supply or irrigation modeller can calibrate soil-crop simulations across management intensities. The three plots at one station do not represent all soils or farming systems. File-level coverage and quality were not checked by download, and the visible map page did not expose a direct XML route. This deposit is related to the four-field crop rotation G4-0568 at the same station, but the three intensity plots and DOI differ. The previous candidate screen rejected single-site research data; the journal describes its use in reusable model comparisons.
name: Comprehensive multivariable field data set for agro-ecosystem modelling from Muencheberg Experimental Stations in 1992 - 1998
